analysis.summary: Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Limited reported a strong first half of FY27, with H1 pre-sales reaching INR879 crores and total revenue growing 69% year-on-year to INR401 crores. Management highlighted robust performance in the luxury residential and commercial segments, supported by net cash positions and strategic project additions in Mumbai. The company reiterated its full-year FY27 guidance of pre-sales between INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores along with strong profitability margins. Looking ahead, management plans to launch four projects in the second half of the fiscal year. Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Limited reported a strong financial and operational performance for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, with significant growth in pre-sales, revenue, and profitability.

guidance.claim: The company remains confident of delivering FY27 pre-sales ranging from INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores.
guidance.quote: Together with the momentum from our recent launches and a growing pipeline, we remain confident of delivering our FY27 guideline of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60% over FY26 levels.

guidance.claim: EBITDA margin is expected to be sustained between 35% to 40% for FY27.
guidance.quote: We also remain confident of sustaining strong profitability, with EBITDA and PAT margin expected at 35% to 40% and 25% to 30%, respectively.

guidance.claim: The company remains confident of delivering its stated guidance for FY27 of pre-sales between 1,800 and 2,000 Crs, and revenue and PAT growth of 55-60% over FY26 levels.
guidance.quote: We remain confident of delivering our stated guidance for FY27 of a pre-sales of INR 1,800-2,000 Crs, and revenue and PAT growth of 55-60% over FY26 levels.

guidance.claim: The company remains committed to its FY27 guidance of pre-sales between INR1,800 to 2,000 crores and revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.
guidance.quote: Backed by this launch pipeline, strong demand outlook, and the quality of our developments, we remain committed to our FY27 guidance of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 to 2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.

guidance.claim: Management expects EBITDA margins at 35% to 40% and PAT margins at 25% to 30% for FY27.
guidance.quote: We remain confident of sustaining strong profitability with EBITDA and PAT margins expected at 35% to 40% and 25% to 30%, respectively.

demand_outlook.claim: Mumbai remains India's largest housing market with sales in the first nine months of calendar 2026 at their highest since 2018, led by the luxury segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Mumbai remains India’s largest housing market, with sales in the first nine months of calendar 2026 at their highest since 2018, and the luxury segment continues to lead.

demand_outlook.claim: Prime residential prices rose 6.2% year-on-year in the first half of the calendar year.
demand_outlook.quote: In the first half of the calendar year, sales of homes priced above INR10 crores reached a record of over INR18,500 crores, while prime residential prices rose 6.2% year-on-year, more than twice the global average.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand is primarily driven by end-users upgrading to larger homes in better locations.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand is driven largely by end users upgrading to larger homes in better locations, while scarce land in prime micromarkets makes redevelopment the principal route to new supply, precisely where Lotus has built its capability.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the luxury segment is far less sensitive to borrowing costs as buyers rely less on home loans.
demand_outlook.quote: While this is likely to weigh on affordable and mid-income housing, the luxury segment is far less sensitive to borrowing costs. Our buyers rely far less on home loans and buy for long-term value and lifestyle.

demand_outlook.claim: Q2 FY27 pre-sales grew 83% YoY to 470 Crs, reflecting sustained demand for the company's premium offerings.
demand_outlook.quote: Pre-sales for Q2 FY27 grew 83% YoY to INR 470 Crs.

demand_outlook.claim: There is strong demand from financial institutions, fintech firms, and allied sectors for Grade-A commercial spaces, coupled with high enquiry levels for luxury residential units in the GIFT City project.
demand_outlook.quote: Strong demand from financial institutions, fintech firms, and allied sectors for Grade-A commercial spaces, coupled with differentiated project positioning and strong brand name translating into high enquiry levels for luxury residential units.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand is spread across the portfolio rather than resting on a single project.
demand_outlook.quote: Q2 FY27 pre-sales grew 83% YoY to INR 470 Crs, with six projects contributing, which shows that demand is spread across the portfolio rather than resting on a single project.

demand_outlook.claim: Luxury housing demand across Mumbai has grown by more than 11%, led by upgrades from successful families and professionals.
demand_outlook.quote: While most buyers globally are being cautious, given interest rates and broader uncertainty, luxury buyers are not. They are driven by long-term wealth creation, family legacy, and lifestyle, not by loan rates.

demand_outlook.claim: Supply in micro-markets like Worli, Bandra, and South Mumbai remains constrained with very little fresh land left.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, supply in micro-markets like Worli, Bandra, and South Mumbai remain constrained.

capex_expansion.claim: The company added three new projects namely Lotus Impressa at Shivaji Park, Lotus Stellar in Versova, and Lotus Supremus in Juhu during the quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: Three new projects added, Lotus Impressa at Shivaji Park in Dadar West, Lotus Stellar in Versova, and Lotus Supremus in Juhu, which adds INR2,700 to INR2,800 crores of GDV to existing GDV pipeline.

capex_expansion.claim: The ongoing and upcoming pipeline comprises 24 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR20,000 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: With these additions, our ongoing and upcoming pipeline now comprises 24 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR20,000 crores, of which 19 are redevelopment-led.

capex_expansion.claim: Four projects are planned for launch in the second half of the year with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to INR4,000 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We plan to launch four projects, Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to INR4,000 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company was appointed as preferred developer for three new projects: Lotus Supremus, Lotus Empressa, and Lotus Stellar, alongside additional area secured for Lotus Insignia, adding 2,700-2,800 Crs of GDV.
capex_expansion.quote: We also made significant progress on business development during the quarter, where company was appointed as preferred developer for three new projects: Lotus Supremus (Juhu), Lotus Empressa (Shivaji Park, Dadar West), Lotus Stellar (Versova) and additional area secured for Lotus Insignia which together adds INR 2,700-2,800 Crs of GDV.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded into the GIFT City area with a flagship ultra-luxury mixed-use project having an estimated GDV of 2,000-2,200 Crs.
capex_expansion.quote: Expansion in GIFT City Area with Flagship Ultra Luxury Project

capex_expansion.claim: During the quarter, the company launched Lotus Trident in Andheri and Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi, representing a combined GDV of INR1,350 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: During the quarter, we launched two new projects, Lotus Trident in Andheri and Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi, together representing a combined GDV of INR1,350 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company was appointed developer for a commercial redevelopment project in Juhu with an estimated GDV of INR1,600 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We were also recently appointed developer for a very, very prestigious commercial redevelopment project with an estimated GDV of INR1,600 crores in Juhu.

margins_costs.claim: Q2 FY27 total revenue rose 53% year-on-year to INR269 crores, while EBITDA more than doubled to INR107 crores with margins expanding to 39.9%.
margins_costs.quote: In Q2, total revenue rose 53% year-on-year to INR269 crores. EBITDA more than doubled to INR107 crores, with margins expanding to 39.9%.

margins_costs.claim: H1 FY27 revenue stood at INR401 crores, EBITDA at INR155 crores with a 38.80% margin, and PAT at INR134 crores with a 33.5% margin.
margins_costs.quote: For the first half, revenue stood at INR401 crores, up 69%, EBITDA at INR155 crores, up 95%, and PAT at INR134 crores, up 86% at an improved PAT margin of 33.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Management cited the net debt-free status, limited marketing expenses, fast project cycles, efficient fund deployment, and premium pricing policy as drivers of strong margins.
margins_costs.quote: As far as margins are concerned, as I have mentioned earlier, we are a net debt-free company. So, we don't have to pay or we don't have any burden of interest. Second, till today, we have not done any marketing expenses, very limited awareness campaign we did. So, that is where we don't spend much money on that. Third is our project cycle is very fast. We generally complete our all the projects between 2.5 years to 3.5 years. So, because of that, our deployment of fund is very efficient, and that gives us a great sales velocity. We have got better pricing, you know, premium pricing policy. So, all this five contributes to good EBITDA margin and PAT margin both, and I'm sure that this will continue.

margins_costs.claim: In Q2, total revenue rose 53% YoY to 269 Crs, EBITDA more than doubled to 107 Crs at a margin of 39.9%, and PAT grew 91% to 89 Crs.
margins_costs.quote: In Q2, total revenue rose 53% YoY to INR 269 Crs, EBITDA more than doubled to INR 107 Crs at a margin of 39.9%, and PAT grew 91% to INR 89 Crs.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax grew 77% year-on-year to INR46 crores, achieving a PAT margin of 34.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax grew 77% year-on-year to INR46 crores, at a PAT margin of 34.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 EBITDA stood at INR48 crores with an EBITDA margin of 36.4%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR48 crores, growing 63% year-on-year with a healthy EBITDA margin of 36.4%.

orders_capacity.claim: For H1 FY27, pre-sales stood at 879 Crs, up 176% YoY.
orders_capacity.quote: For H1 FY27, pre-sales stood at INR 879 Crs, up 176% YoY and on track to achieve our full-year guidance.

orders_capacity.claim: The ongoing and upcoming pipeline comprises 22 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR17,500 to 18,000 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Our ongoing and upcoming pipeline comprises 22 projects, 17 residential and 5 commercial, with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR17,500 to 18,000 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: Seventeen out of the 22 projects in the pipeline are redevelopment-led.
orders_capacity.quote: Notably, 17 of these 22 projects are redevelopment-led, reinforcing our core focus and competitive strength in this segment.

capital_allocation.claim: As of September 30, 2026, the company had a net cash position of INR494 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As of 30th September 2026, we had a net cash position of INR494 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised approximately INR792 crores through the fresh issue of its IPO with net proceeds of approximately INR732 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We raised approximately INR792 crores through the fresh issue of our IPO, with net proceeds of approximately INR732 crores after issue expenses, of which INR550 crores earmarked for our subsidiary for the Amalfi, Arcadian, and Varun.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of the IPO proceeds, INR550 crores was earmarked for the subsidiary for Amalfi, Arcadian, and Varun, and INR305 crores had been deployed as on September 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: We raised approximately INR792 crores through the fresh issue of our IPO, with net proceeds of approximately INR732 crores after issue expenses, of which INR550 crores earmarked for our subsidiary for the Amalfi, Arcadian, and Varun. INR305 crores had been deployed as on 30th September 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Total cash stood at 646 Crs, including lien fixed deposits of 62 Crs, against debt outstanding of 152 Crs.
capital_allocation.quote: Total Cash of INR 646 Crs. . including lien fixed deposit of INR 62 Crs. Debt outstanding of INR 152 Crs.

capital_allocation.claim: As of June 2026, total cash balance was approximately INR776 crores against debt of INR153 crores, resulting in a net cash position of INR623 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As of June 2026, we had a total cash balance of approximately INR776 crores against debt of INR153 crores, resulting in a net cash position of INR623 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of INR550 crores earmarked for a subsidiary towards Amalfi, Arcadian, and Varun, INR271 crores has been deployed as of June 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Of the INR550 crores earmarked for our subsidiary towards Amalfi, Arcadian, and Varun, we have deployed INR271 crores as on 30th June 2026, and the utilization remains in line with our planned deployment schedule.

risks_headwinds.claim: The RBI raised the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.5% earlier in the month, which is likely to weigh on affordable and mid-income housing.
risks_headwinds.quote: Earlier this month, RBI raised the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.5%, its first increase since early 2023. While this is likely to weigh on affordable and mid-income housing, the luxury segment is far less sensitive to borrowing costs.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains confident of delivering the FY27 guidance of pre-sales between INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores.
management_commitments.quote: Together with the momentum from our recent launches and a growing pipeline, we remain confident of delivering our FY27 guideline of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60% over FY26 levels.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to launch four projects in the second half of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We plan to launch four projects, Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to INR4,000 crores.

Four launches are planned for the second half of FY27: Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, Lotus Odyssey, and Lotus Aurelia.
management_commitments.quote: As we enter the second half, we are well prepared. Four launches are planned, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, Lotus Odyssey, and Lotus Aurelia with a combined estimated GDV of ~INR 3,500-4,000 Crs.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to launch four more projects over the remainder of FY27 with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to 4,000 crores.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, we plan to launch four more projects over the remainder of FY27: Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to 4,000 crores.
